files.description: This test file covers the photo gallery feature. It includes tests for verifying that images load correctly without broken links, that video cards show posters/duration and play inline via the ▶ badge, that filtering by year works via the custom searchable-select widget, and that pagination (page size, First/Next/Last navigation, disabled states) works.

testContext: The tests rely on the following selectors: `.photo-grid` for the main gallery container, `.photo-card` for individual photo items, `.photo-date` for the card date, and role locators for buttons/links like `getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply Filters' })` and `getByRole('link', { name: 'Next ›' })`. IMPORTANT: every `
explanation: 2026-07-01: Added gallery_loads_with_valid_videos for the new seeded video items: verifies video cards (filtered via /?media-type=video), poster sources return 200 and aren't the fallback placeholder, the duration badge renders, the /media/{id} stream is servable, and the ▶ badge starts inline playback (currentTime advances, .is-playing set, poster hidden) which can be paused without navigating away. Earlier fix round (same day): searchable-select widget interactions and URL regex waits. All 4 tests pass.
